description.value: White Spot is BC's longest-running restaurant chain, founded in 1928 and still serving its legendary burgers made from 100% fresh Canadian beef alongside a broad family menu at this Kerrisdale location. The West Boulevard spot sits in a walkable, bikeable neighbourhood and offers a patio as well as full dine-in service. Touring cyclists will find familiar comfort food, takeout and delivery options, and a well-known brand with dozens of locations across BC for route planning.
